reviews.title: Too much data sharing
reviews.text: I feel that smart closet needs too much of our personal identifiers and so today I switched to a more privacy forward option option,

reviews.title: Does not work anymore on iPad
reviews.text:
BUYER BEWARE! There is no longer customer service support. You can lose access to your data because there isn’t a way to access without the app.

The app has stopped allowing sign-in on iPad.

reviews.title: What's the Point
reviews.text:
I completely couldn't believe that 2 years of collecting images for this app was gone in an update. The Pro Version is linked to my Facebook and it won't log in. 

I understand that apps sometimes do not care, right? However, the company won't even answer emails regarding this matter. What's the point of taking our money but not giving the dedicated users an heads up? This is tragic and neglectful of Rabbit Tech.

reviews.title: Fix the categories please!!
reviews.text: Categories are not showing up creating a set. Please fix this! Will give 5 stars when the categories are back functioning.

reviews.title: Lost all my data
reviews.text: I was suddenly logged out of my account and all my data is gone. I previously paid to have my data backed up, yet none of it is loading back when I attempt to log back into my account. I am missing my entire closet and lookbook, both of which I have accumulated over the course of years. I am hoping there’s a way to restore everything!!!!! Seems like a lot of people are dealing with this

reviews.title: Lost all my data
reviews.text: Terrible app , I paid used it for a year, it’s a lot of work to add items over a year, all the wardrobe items disappeared… there’s no contact to reach to fix this issue , I don’t recommend
